summary: Splash screen from the HD logo art
author: pm
body:
The user, 2026-11-25: "Updated the splash screen", at `working/classic_ui/hd/splash_screen.png`.

| fact | value |
|---|---|
| new art | 1920x1080 RGBA, fully transparent except the logo, alpha bbox (679,365)-(1241,716). The transparent pixels are white (255,255,255,0) - measured |
| old art | intermediate_screens sprite 3, loaded in `screen_splash.cpp:26-28` as SplashScreen (as of 2026-11-25) |
| keep | the credits roll in screen_splash.cpp |

Follows d-035 and d-036: HD only, no fallback, old art archived.

**Done when:** the splash draws the new logo (art_fit, on black, with no white halo at its edges), the old sprite 3 load is gone, sprite 3 is an empty placeholder archived byte-identical, the build is clean, and the user has approved an in-client shot.

Source: user message, 2026-11-25.

**Closed, 2026-11-25:** commit beaba884, with the old 003.png deletion in 0cff2f0d. The archive is byte-identical (hash checked). The user approved hh0107_splash_mine.png and the review passed. The SplashScreen id is still in sprite_id.h until the loader cleanup.
